motions.item_title: Approve the minutes of July 28, 2026, Planning Commission meeting with the correction of adding…
motions.motion: Commissioner Strong moved to approve the minutes of July 28, 2026, Planning Commission meeting with the correction of adding Commissioner Hess to Item 7.A. as the Commissioner who made the motion. Commissioner Hess seconded the motion.
